archetype: Archetype 4 (Swiss & High-Contrast) infused with Techno-Futurist aesthetics.
philosophy: The product IS the design. Ultra-premium, zero-clutter, relying on architectural grids, massive contrast, asymmetric bento box layouts, and perfect typography. The accent is a high-energy Electric Vermilion to contrast the deep Obsidian base.

colors.notes: Ensure text contrast always meets APCA standards. DO NOT use generic gray. The 'Vermilion' (#FF4500) acts as the single energetic CTA trigger on a stealthy dark background.

hierarchy_rules.h1: text-5xl sm:text-6xl lg:text-[5rem] tracking-tighter leading-none font-medium

typography.installation: Use Fontsource or Google Fonts for Clash Display and Satoshi if available, otherwise fallback to Space Grotesk for headings and Inter for body, BUT prefer Clash Display/Satoshi heavily.

layout_and_spacing.grid_system: The Bento Grid Protocol (Universal). Mode A 'Tetris Grid' for Marketing pages (gap-8, wide asymmetry). Mode B 'Control Room Grid' for Dashboards (gap-4, dense).
layout_and_spacing.asymmetry: Hero sections must be horizontal/asymmetrical. Avoid standard 'center everything'. Use 60/40 splits with inverted border radii or complex overlapping.
layout_and_spacing.spacing: Generous spacing. p-8 to p-12 in cards. py-32 for sections.

components_strategy.marketing_pages: Pure HTML/Tailwind + Framer Motion. Do not use Shadcn for standard structural sections. Use raw tags for overlapping/asymmetry. Implement scroll-triggered reveals.
components_strategy.dashboard_and_editor: Use Shadcn highly customized. Strip away the generic look. Use 'Glassmorphism' with backdrop-blur-xl and border-white/10 for sticky headers and overlays. Use 'Grid Borders' (technical look) for data tables and settings.
components_strategy.buttons: Premium feel. Primary: bg-primary text-white shadow-[0_0_20px_rgba(255,69,0,0.4)] hover:shadow-[0_0_30px_rgba(255,69,0,0.6)] hover:-translate-y-0.5 transition-all duration-300. Secondary: bg-white/5 border border-white/10 hover:bg-white/10 backdrop-blur-md.
components_strategy.cards: Dark mode cards: bg-card border border-border/50 hover:border-white/20 transition-colors. Add a subtle radial gradient highlight on hover using framer-motion or CSS pseudo-elements.

hero_background.description: Ultra-premium 3D abstract geometric shape, sleek dark obsidian material with bright vermilion glowing accents. Use as absolute background in the Hero section, masked or faded at edges.

texture_overlay.description: Monochrome geometric texture. Use as a fixed background layer with opacity-5 and mix-blend-overlay to create a subtle premium grain/structure.

key_functionalities: Landing page SaaS premium (hero asymétrique, features bento grid, templates showcase carousel, how-it-works, testimonials, CTA).
Dashboard utilisateur moderne (grid of projects with preview thumbs, create new, duplicate, version history).
Multi-step intelligent form wizard (business info, sector, location, style, colors, services, tone, sections). Use smooth framer-motion slide transitions.
AI Generation flow with premium loading states / shimmer effects.
Site editor panel (edit text inline, change colors, add/remove sections) using a control room UI.
SEO score dashboard (0-100 circular score with checklist) using custom SVG or Recharts.
Export ZIP button with success micro-interaction.
Dark/light mode toggle (both themes strictly polished, dark mode default).
Premium templates showcase for 15 sectors, utilizing provided thumbnail URLs.

accessibility_and_testing.requirements: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a 'data-testid' attribute (e.g., data-testid='generate-site-button'). Ensure hover and focus states provide high contrast via APCA standards. Respect prefers-reduced-motion.

instructions_to_main_agent: 1. Setup Tailwind using the exact CSS variables provided. Configure dark mode to 'class'.
2. Install and use lucide-react for icons.
3. Use Framer Motion for scroll reveals (fade-up) and the multi-step wizard transitions.

4. Build the Marketing page first with an asymmetric hero, embedding the `hero_background` image with a dark gradient overlay (e.g., bg-gradient-to-r from-background via-background/80 to-transparent) so text is 100% readable.
5. For the AI Generation Flow, build a high-end shimmer/pulse loading screen. Do NOT use standard spinners. Use skeleton layouts that pulse with a 'Tracing Beam' or subtle gradients.
6. Build the Site Editor Panel using a sleek, dense 'Control Room' sidebar (Mode B Grid) and a large central Live Preview.
7. Include all 10 key functionalities fully built and styled.
8. Add data-testid to EVERY button, link, and form field.
